title: The $\varepsilon^6$ leading coefficient of $F_3 - 1$ at $q = 1 + \varepsilon$ equals $-2\,b(1)^3 = -3\sqrt{3}/4$
html:
Exact-arithmetic lemma: the leading \varepsilon^6 coefficient of (F_3 - 1) at q = 1 + \varepsilon equals -2 \cdot b^3(q=1) = -3\sqrt{3}/4.

Statement

For the F_3 = 1 - 2 b^3 \hbar_q^6 factor in the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta categorical-derivation precision ladder precision ladder, the leading \varepsilon^6 contribution of (F_3 - 1) at q = 1+\varepsilon is the exact algebraic value:

\boxed{
  -2 \cdot b^3(q=1) \;=\; -2 \cdot \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{8} \;=\; -\frac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}
   \;\approx\; -1.29904 .
}

This value is checked by exact symbolic computation and proved below.

Proof

The Hoefsmit off-diagonal coupling is b = \sqrt{q^4+q^2+1}/(q^2+1). At q = 1, b^2 = 3/4, hence b = \sqrt{3}/2. Thus b^3 = 3\sqrt{3}/8, and -2 \cdot b^3 = -3\sqrt{3}/4.

Significance

This lemma is the purely-arithmetic component of the c_3 = -2 identification in Categorical derivation of c_3 = J_{\mathrm{Hopf}}(q=1) = -2 via 3-fold Markov closure. The categorical content remains a hypothesis (the three-fold Markov Hopf extraction), but its arithmetic discharge at the \varepsilon^6 level is proved.

Combined with Primitive Markov-trace axioms, two previously assumed hypotheses are replaced by purely algebraic/arithmetic theorems. The substantive open content of the three-fold Markov Hopf extraction reduces to the categorical identification that the perturbative \hbar_q^6 piece of the \mathrm{tr}_M-expansion factors through Hopf-link Jones values.
